candidates.claim: The VENDOR_VPN entry at fw-01:82 is the first match for VENDOR traffic (vpn-filter binding at fw-01:133) and permits tcp/3389 from 172.16.50.0/24 to SCADA server 10.10.10.20 in OT, so vendor VPN users can open a connection directly into the OT side.
candidates.remediation: Remove the permit at fw-01:82 so that vendor VPN users have no path into OT and reach only the jump host 10.10.20.30.

candidates.claim: Through the VENDOR_VPN vpn-filter (fw-01:133), the permit at fw-01:82 lets vendor VPN users reach SCADA server 10.10.10.20 on tcp/3389, although the only approved vendor destination is the jump host 10.10.20.30.
candidates.remediation: Remove the permit at fw-01:82 so that the VENDOR path is limited to the jump host 10.10.20.30 on tcp/3389 (fw-01:83).

candidates.claim: The baseline_delta record shows that the access-list VENDOR_VPN entry at fw-01:82 was added and is not in the approved baseline.
candidates.remediation: Reconcile the added VENDOR_VPN entry at fw-01:82 against the approved baseline and remove it unless the change is approved.
